3.t: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?

4.t: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blow would come:

5.t: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;

6.t: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind

7.t: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.

8.t: Can you see any trace of them now?

9.t: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

10.t: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.

11.t: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,

12.t: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.

13.t: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,

14.t: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,

15.t: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.

16.t: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.

17.t: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.

18.t: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

19.t: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.

20.t: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’

21.t: and so he will have a pleasant life

23.t: with clustered fruit within his reach.

24.t: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’

25.t: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record

26.t: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.

27.t: How I wish death had been the end of me.

28.t: My wealth has been no use to me,

30.t: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,

31.t: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,

32.t: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:

33.t: he would not believe in Almighty God,

34.t: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,

35.t: so today he has no real friend here,

36.t: and the only food he has is the filth

38.t: So I swear by what you can see

39.t: and by what you cannot see:

40.t: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,

41.t: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-

42.t: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!

43.t: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:

44.t: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,

45.t: We would certainly have seized his right hand

47.t: and none of you could have defended him.

48.t: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.

49.t: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-

50.t: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-

51.t: but it is in fact the certain Truth.

52.t: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
